method: Hash-checked, bounded CPU-only continuation. No native sample execution, Windows process creation, host DLL opening, remote process access or sample-endpoint contact. OS results and DLL metadata are explicitly synthetic.

findings.conclusion: The old zero length came from the empty export-directory RVA in the synthetic DLL. Five CPU controls replay the original 174-byte range-setup block and independently vary these fields.

modeled_copy.assumption: NtReadVirtualMemory succeeds using only the pre-captured synthetic DLL snapshot; no remote process exists

findings.interpretation: The read direction copies modeled child DLL bytes into the current process at the same DLL address, followed by termination of that child. This supports DLL restoration/unhooking. The supplied synthetic bytes are identical before and after the modeled copy; this does not establish injection into that first child.

capture.assumption: one additional synthetic suspended child succeeds; no host process exists

findings.conclusion: The second CreateProcessInternalW call uses CREATE_SUSPENDED and receives a distinct synthetic process handle, 0x61000003.

NtOpenFile requests read access to the windir-derived SysWOW64\mshtml.dll path. NtCreateSection uses that synthetic file handle and SEC_IMAGE (0x01000000). NtMapViewOfSection targets the second synthetic child handle. The mapping request is captured before any mapping result is supplied.
findings.path_provenance: windir=, \SysWOW64\ and mshtml.dll are decoded stage inputs; C:\Windows is the explicit synthetic environment value, not a recovered host path.

model_corrections.change: Supply the ordinary x86 TEB self-pointer through FS:18 and allow only a segment-prefixed DWORD read at that low-page alias. The prior missing field wrongly entered the exception handler and then junk code.

controls.empty_environment: With FS:18 supplied but no windir entry, the trace stalls in the environment-search helper at stage+0x1a720 and hits the emulator slice bound. This is a model-environment control, not proof of a loop under a normal Windows environment.
controls.pre_correction_fs18: Before the FS:18 correction, an ordinary TEB read was mistaken for an obfuscation fault and diverted into junk code. That path is superseded.
controls.post_mapping_exploration: A separate symbolic-map probe, not the authoritative run, supplied only a synthetic remote base and extent. It then searched synthetic ntdll section headers in 0x28-byte steps for the .dat prefix (0x7461642e); the missing section exhausted the exception budget. It also requested export hash 0x8bfb3ee0, unresolved among 21,116 cached API candidates. This establishes the need for better native-image/export metadata before interpreting later behavior.

limits: NtMapViewOfSection is not executed or given a result in the authoritative reproduction. No payload write, thread redirection or execution in the second child has been established.

Windows DLL fields, function prologues, module layout, command line and environment are synthetic. The continuation needs more faithful native section/export metadata; no actual ntdll.dll or mshtml.dll image was found in the checked system/sample/fixture paths.

The new driver retains earlier marker/module absence, Windows-version, window-count, thread-information, debug-port, allocation and child-success assumptions. File/section handle success is an additional assumption.

Each additional continuation uses bounded instruction budgets; run_trace has a 120-second outer limit, 20-second Unicorn slices and at most 20,000 exception transitions per invocation. Sparse backing is capped at 32 MiB and disallows execution.
No final payload, malware-family identity, usable endpoint or sparse-companion relationship is recovered. The production NSIS instruction-stream extraction gap remains.

verification.full_taxonomy_validation: Not repeated for this model/report-only pass; prior full validation remains in review.json.

section_continuation_update.status: Hash 0x8bfb3ee0 is now identified as kernel32!BaseThreadInitThunk. The matching ntdll .data-pointer branch reaches an overwrite request targeting relocated loader code in the second child; the no-match control terminates that child.
